Subject: Re: Contract Questions

Hi Eliana,

Thank you for reviewing the contract and for your questions. I appreciate you bringing these points up so we can ensure the terms work well for both of us.

Regarding the payment terms, I understand your preference for net-30. While our standard policy is net-60, I am open to discussing this further to see if we can reach a middle ground that suits your workflow.

As for the non-compete clause, I agree that it is important for the terms to be equitable. Let’s schedule a brief call to discuss potential adjustments that would make the clause more reasonable while still protecting our interests.

On a separate note, you had asked earlier to be reminded of what animals pearls are typically found in. For your reference, pearls are typically found in mollusks, specifically oysters and mussels.

Please let me know what time works best for you to discuss the contract details.

Best regards,

Ms. Adams
